scheme_name: Soft Loan Scheme for Women Entrepreneurs
other_conditions: Startup must be approved by DPIIT and have a Unique ID issued by Kerala Startup Mission.
Women co‑founder must hold the majority stake in the startup.
Startup must be registered in Kerala.
The client must be a Government Department or Public Sector Undertaking.
Startup must sign an agreement with Kerala Startup Mission before availing the benefit.
A personal guarantee must be executed by the women founder for availing the loan.
For service enterprises, at least 51% of shares must be held by women founders; for equity‑funded enterprises, majority shares must remain with women founders.
benefits_summary: Soft loan up to ₹15 Lakhs at 6% simple interest, disbursed up to 80% of the purchase order with repayment within 1 year or upon project completion, whichever is earlier.
